decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;<span style="line-height: normal;">Reasonable Exception Statement; Design &amp; Heritage Statement; 24007 HH4 01.05 (Pre-Existing Plans); 24007 HH4 01.04 (Approved Plans); 24007 HH4 01.02 (Existing Plans); 24007 HH4 01.01 (Location Plan); 24007 HH4 01.03 (Proposed Plans).</span>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 6px; line-height: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Notwithstanding the approved plans, within 3 months of the date of this
decision, details of a mature landscape screening scheme for the area/gap
between the amended patio (set in 1.5m from the boundary shared with 20 West
Drive) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning
Authority.&nbsp; The landscape scheme shall
include: planting plans (at a scale not less than 1:100), written specification
of planting and cultivation works to be undertaken and schedules of plants,
noting species, plant sizes (to be at least 1.8m high at the time of planting)
and proposed numbers / densities.&nbsp; The
landscape scheme shall be undertaken within the first planting season following
the completion of the development.&nbsp; Any
existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the
completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged,
diseased or defective, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with
others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any
variation in writing.</p>
description: Single storey side extension; conversion of garage into art studio ancillary to dwelling; single storey rear extension; front porch; external alterations; patio ground level marginally raised and rear garden levelled along the south boundary; (part retrospective)
